description: Core permissions for the MediaSearchAgent window. The SPA reaches the backend with plain fetch() to the injected 127.0.0.1 URL, so no extra plugin permissions are needed in the webview; the sidecar is spawned from Rust (which bypasses the JS permission system). core:window:allow-destroy lets the close-while-indexing guard programmatically close the window after the user confirms quit — onCloseRequested itself is covered by core:default's event permissions.
